# KASHFARA VISION & KASHFARA SPREADSHEET — Full Technical & Engineering Reference

Canonical Site: https://kashfara.com
Document Intelligence Live Demo: https://kashfara.com/demo
Kashfara Spreadsheet: https://kashfara.com/spreadsheet
Spreadsheet Live Demo: https://kashfara.com/spreadsheet/demo
Enterprise Sales & Air-Gapped Deployment: enquiry@kashfara.com

## 1. Entity & Product Summary
KASHFARA VISION is an enterprise multimodal document intelligence platform built around a compact 4-billion-parameter (4B) OCR + Vision architecture specialized for Arabic (RTL), English (LTR), and bilingual documents. Alongside it, KASHFARA SPREADSHEET provides an agentic Excel/CSV workspace with in-cell `k=` AI prompts, range-aware copilot editing, cell coloring, and visual bar/pie chart reporting.

## 2. Under-the-Hood Architecture
1. **Magic-Byte Ingestion & Format Validation**: Validates binary file signatures (`%PDF-`, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TIFF, and Office Open XML archives) and enforces page/size limits before any processing begins.
2. **Hybrid Structural + Sparse-PDF OCR Pipeline**:
   - Digital PDFs: Extracts native text items and normalizes `[0..1]` coordinates grouped by horizontal line baseline.
   - Images & Sparse/Scanned PDFs: When native text is `<250` characters or `<10` lines, automatically runs dual-script (`eng+ara`) OCR to recover the full page text and line bounding boxes.
   - Office Documents (DOCX, PPTX, XLSX): Parses paragraphs, slides, sheets, and cell references structurally without inventing pixel coordinates.
3. **Evidence Verification Engine (`SourceMatcher` + `EvidenceValidator`)**:
   - Normalizes Arabic diacritics and whitespace to match extracted values and verbatim `source_text` against OCR blocks.
   - Distinguishes `model_proposed`, `source_matched`, and `visually_verified` coordinates, assigning `VERIFIED`, `NEEDS_REVIEW`, or `NOT_FOUND`.
4. **5 Smart Templates + Conditional Resume ATS + Unstructured Intelligence**:
   - Automatically detects `resume`, `invoice`, `bank_statement`, `contract`, `receipt`, or `generic`.
   - Extracts entities (people, organizations, dates, monetary values, locations, reference IDs), semantic clauses/sections with risk notes, action items, and English translations for Arabic/non-English documents.
   - For resumes, unlocks an integrated ATS Job-Description matcher (`0–100` score, matched/missing skills, recommendations).
5. **Grounded Document Q&A & Automatic Form Digitalisation**:
   - Answers questions strictly from retrieved document pages and fields with clickable page citations.
   - Converts paper/scanned forms into editable digital forms with Arabic RTL toggle, JSON/CSV export, and print support.
6. **Multi-Engine Orchestration & JSON Repair**:
   - Bounded execution budgets, truncated-JSON bracket repair, prompt-injection isolation (treating all document text as untrusted data), and automatic engine failover.

## 3. Why Building In-House Fails (Build vs. Buy Reality)
Hiring a few engineers to "hook up OCR + an LLM API" fails in enterprise production for concrete engineering reasons:
- **Silent Extraction Failures on Real-World PDFs**: Commercial resumes, invoices, and contracts frequently mix vector outlines with partial text layers. Naive `pdfplumber` or `pdfjs` scripts extract only a few header lines while silently dropping 90% of the document.
- **Arabic RTL & Bilingual Layout Complexity**: Mixed Arabic-English tables, RTL reading order, Arabic diacritics, and currency/date normalization break standard Western OCR pipelines.
- **Zero Auditability Without Deterministic Proofing**: An LLM returning JSON without `SourceMatcher` + coordinate validation cannot prove where a number came from—unacceptable for banking, VAT/ZATCA auditing, and legal teams.
- **Ongoing Maintenance, Drift & Failover**: Model deprecations, rate-limit storms (HTTP 429), truncated JSON outputs, and serverless timeout tuning require continuous MLOps engineering (`[INSERT BENCHMARK METRIC: engineering months to build and maintain in-house]`).
- **Air-Gapped Security & Governance**: Deploying a low-compute 4B model stack inside an air-gapped enterprise or bank network with zero external data leakage requires specialized packaging and security controls.
